observations.im: Official Open Positions link confirms existing Adrenalin tenant. Corporate access problems are not evidence that the tenant URL is wrong. Collector/API remains unverified.
observations.moriental: Four public career records6725–6728 match four scoped HTML cards with explicit Nairobi,Kenya and fulltime metadata. WordPress record6728 is the developer role; public individual page and HR application email were verified. Dates are not displayed by the collected job-card template, so publish first-found separately rather than invent a posting/closing date. Public API confirms CMS publication6October2026, kept separately in discovery evidence.
observations.sumac: Correct official careers portal is employer-owned /vacancies/. Supplied Greenhouse board was not officially linked. Inspected post6957 covers two relationship-officer roles dated10September2025; no eligible technical job verified.
observations.salaam: Regulator still lists supplied .co.ke employer domain. No replacement recruitment portal was established; SalaamPay banking app is not a job board.
observations.prime: Official indexed careers page says no vacancies, but robots restriction remains; do not use search retrieval as a production collection bypass.

restrictions: No proxy, altered user-agent or blocked-endpoint workaround introduced. Collection review covers bounded public vacancy facts and original employer application entry points; it does not grant a reuse licence.
